subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Making something brighter does not always make it better.”?
options: Sometimes it means choosing which parts must remain and which parts must change so a place can live again.
At night, even familiar things can make people ask new questions.
Design must ask what a place already means before adding attention.
Sometimes learning means adding names back to the story.
